about.title: Protecting what matters most: a legacy of care.
text: Harlan Insurance Agency has proudly served Houston since 2004. Founded by Bruce Harlan, a small business owner and family man, the agency was built on a simple belief: people deserve honest protection from someone who truly cares.

As an independent insurance agency, we focus on helping Houston families and businesses find coverage that fits their lives, not a one-size-fits-all policy. Bruce understands firsthand the responsibility of protecting a family and running a business, and that perspective drives our commitment to personalized service, trust and long-term relationships.
At Harlan Insurance Agency, we're here to help, guide and protect. Every client, every step of the way.

faqs.q: What makes Harlan Insurance Agency different?
faqs.a: Established in 2004 by Bruce Harlan, the agency brings over 20 years of industry experience and a commitment to personalized attention, trust and integrity. As an independent agency, we provide diverse insurance services tailored to the needs of each client.

faqs.q: What kinds of insurance do you write?
faqs.a: We offer customized coverage across home, auto, flood, life and commercial insurance, along with renters, umbrella, jewelry, boat and marine, RV, general liability, workers' compensation, inland marine and surety bonds.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to get a quote or a review?
faqs.a: No. Quotes and consultations are complimentary, and we also provide complimentary policy reviews to keep your coverage up to date and comprehensive.

faqs.q: What should I consider when choosing home insurance?
faqs.a: The level of coverage you need, the specific risks in your area, and the value of your home and belongings. It is also worth evaluating the reliability and customer service of potential insurers.

faqs.q: How does commercial insurance protect my business?
faqs.a: It safeguards against a range of potential risks and liabilities, covering things like property damage, legal claims and employee-related risks. We build custom policies designed to fit the needs of each business.

faqs.q: What factors influence flood insurance rates?
faqs.a: A property's flood risk, location and elevation, along with the amount and type of coverage chosen. Many areas in Houston face significant risk, so flood coverage is often necessary.

faqs.q: Where can I find top insurance services in Greater Houston?
faqs.a: Our agency offers a wide range of personalized coverage options across Greater Houston, so every client finds the protection they need. With years of experience and a track record of reliability, we deliver trustworthy, custom-fit solutions for your insurance needs.
